entries.rule: A validator or compiler may not hardcode a frontier version or immutable target path to determine candidate versus active mode.
The only mode inputs are the stable frontier pointer and generic candidate pointer; zero or multiple matching modes fail closed.

An executable ticket is invalid unless the compiler itself verifies active_validation_status=PASS, scientific_execution_authorized=true, authorized_action_scope=MACHINE_ACTION_TICKET_ONLY, exact active-validation receipt pin and exact stable ticket binding.
Validation-only tickets may be generated before the execution latch opens but are never execution authority.
An unresolved pre-scientific evidence blocker preempts the scientific state map and emits exactly one non-economic repair/recovery ticket.
W02 causal scope, W03 universe build and W06 config/hash freeze are now bound to exact V209/V213 authorities; W04 RISE fixed-point is not considered verified without its exact receipt.
FROZEN_MACHINE_CANONICAL is not silently promoted to proof of policy-required POST_EXPANSION_RISE fixed point.
While Seed0076 RISE fixed-point evidence is unresolved, BUILD_FIRST_GATE_SCORER, economic PnL, GA2, holdout and new GA1 execution are forbidden.
Closing the Seed0076 RISE evidence gap may recover the original receipt or perform a non-economic revalidation against the frozen universe; valid completed GA1 work is preserved.

Historical validator workflows remain immutable evidence; only the workflow pinned by the active target is authoritative. Obsolete workflow notifications are non-authoritative noise if they cannot be disabled through available GitHub controls.
Remaining XAU/NQX full-history ZIP uploads improve durable full-history coverage but are not a prerequisite for the current 2018-2019 FIRST_GATE DEV dataset already byte-exact verified.

decision: V4_FROZEN_CANDIDATE: GENERIC MODE RESOLUTION + INTERNAL EXECUTION LATCH + EXPLICIT RISE EVIDENCE BLOCKER
